gloss: to be respectful; to humbly do

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {謹|つつし}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to respectfully do; to humbly offer
definitions.explanation: To perform an action with deep respect and humility. Used in very formal contexts such as official announcements, New Year's greetings, and formal letters. Almost always appears in the form 謹んで (respectfully).

examples.japanese: {謹|つつし}んでお⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
{謹|つつし}んで⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{慶|よろこ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I respectfully offer my New Year's congratulations.

examples.japanese: {謹|つつし}んで⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。

notes: Distinguished from the homophone ⟦{慎|つつし}む→慎む：09158_tsutsushimu⟧, which means 'to be careful/restrained' (self-control). {謹|つつし}む conveys deep respect and reverence, while ⟦{慎|つつし}む→慎む：09158_tsutsushimu⟧ conveys caution and restraint. Almost exclusively used in the て-form {謹|つつし}んで (respectfully, humbly) as a formal prefix to polite expressions. Common collocations: {謹|つつし}んでお⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (humbly accept), {謹|つつし}んで⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧ (respectfully congratulate), {謹|つつし}んで⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧ (offer sincere condolences). Also appears in ⟦{謹賀新年|きんがしんねん}→謹賀新年：17279_kingashinnen⟧ (Happy New Year, formal).
